impact: financial gain by serving malicious advertisements
silent replacement of legitimate apps with malicious versions
mitigation_measures: download apps only from trusted app stores
related_malicious_code_snippet: The malware takes advantage of multiple Android vulnerabilities, such as the Janus flaw and the Man-in-the-Disk flaw, and injects malicious code into the APK files of targeted apps installed on a compromised device.
IOC: 300,000 infected devices in the United States
135,000 infected devices in the United Kingdom
